title: TonksTech's Kingdoms & Nations
description: season 1 of my forever mod pack that ill be using to create a world to inspire and play through
body:
TonksTech: Kingdoms & Nations

(Fabric • 1.20.1)

TonksTech: Kingdoms & Nations is a large-scale Fabric modpack focused on medieval progression, player-built kingdoms, engineering, and exploration.

Players will found nations, build cities and ships, and progress from early medieval tools and combat into advanced Create-powered machinery, cannons, and moving contraptions. The pack blends immersive roleplay, survival difficulty, and technical creativity without losing Minecraft’s sandbox freedom.

You’ll be:

Building castles, towns, and trade routes

Creating ships, trains, and war machines with Create, Valkyrien Skies, and Eureka

Exploring a massively overhauled world with new biomes, dungeons, and structures

Advancing through RPG-style progression, skills, gear, and combat

Running or joining kingdoms, factions, and nations in survival

Designed for long-term worlds, multiplayer servers, and collaborative storytelling, TonksTech supports both builders and engineers, with performance, immersion, and compatibility in mind.
